description: This file defines the LanguageService interface, specifying methods for managing Language entities, including retrieval by code, mapping, list retrieval, and conversions between Language and Locale objects.

classes.name: LanguageService
classes.description: Interface defining language-related operations such as retrieving language data and converting between Language objects and Java Locale objects.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its code, possibly throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getLanguagesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of language codes to Language objects.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Language entities.

methods.name: toLocale
methods.description: Converts a Language object to a Java Locale object.

methods.name: toLanguage
methods.description: Converts a Java Locale to a Language object.
